tenderSchedule.title: Providing Outsourced Manpower Services comprising Data Entry Operators, Drivers, Attenders / Group-D Attenders, Sanitation Workers and Sweepers for the Offices of the Revenue Department, Raichur District
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Outsourced Manpower Services comprising Data Entry Operators, Drivers, Attenders / Group-D Attenders, Sanitation Workers and Sweepers for the Offices of the Revenue Department, Raichur District

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall strictly upload only the documents required under the tender conditions. No additional, irrelevant or unsolicited documents shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should be a legally registered entity (Company/Firm/Proprietorship/Partnership/LLP). Copy of registration certificate shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration certificate and constitution documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have successfully completed at least one similar manpower outsourcing service contract involving deployment of not less than 92 personnel during 2021-22 to 2025-26 in any Government Department, Government agency, local body, PSU or public institution. Work order/agreement and satisfactory completion/performance certificate shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order/agreement and client completion/performance certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Average annual turnover should be minimum Rs.7.40 crore in at least two financial years during 2021-22 to 2025-26. CA-certified turnover certificate with UDIN and audited financial statements shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- CA certificate with UDIN and audited statements

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should possess valid PAN, GST Registration, EPF Registration, ESI Registration and Labour Licence/registration under the applicable contract labour law. Copies shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PAN, GST, EPF, ESI and labour registration/licence

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall submit a declaration on its official letterhead confirming that the service charge quoted in the Financial Bid is not less than 2%. Any bid quoting a service charge below 2%, or failing to submit the required declaration, shall be treated as non-responsive and rejected.

Bidder should not have been blacklisted/debarred by any Government Department/PSU and should not be under an operative debarment order on the bid-submission date. A notarised self-declaration/affidavit shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Notarised affidavit in prescribed format

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Affidavit regarding correctness, blacklisting and acceptance
CA-certified turnover certificate with UDIN and audited statements
Declaration that the quoted service charge is not less than 2 percentage
Details of proposed supervisor/coordinator in Appendix-III
Undertaking to deploy eligible personnel and comply with wage/statutory revisions
